HQL Reports: Export HQL

- improved the ability to download a particular HQL report, using UniTime/export?output=hql-report.csv URL
- academic session can be selected using term parameter
- HQL appearance and admin-only permissions are checked (the user must have the appropriate permissions to be able to get the report)
- report parameter can contain name of the report (instead of unique id)
- individual report...

result.reasoning: This commit ("HQL Reports: Export HQL") introduced the code path that reads `helper.getParameter(option.name())` for single-choice parameters and immediately constructs an IdValue/attempts to parse it as a Long without checking if `value` is null. The fix commit simply wraps this logic in a `if (value != null)` check. Blame on the lines directly preceding the fix traces exactly to this commit, and the diff shows this logic was newly added here as part of a broader export/HQL rewrite, not a mere refactor of prior null-safe code.
